source.title: A1c and 2i1 apply in Fewest Moves Solving
source.content:
DISCLAIMER: Since this was brought to the WRC's attention, regulation [2k6](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/full/#2k6) has been created, which makes it required for competitors to fullfill the requirements  (e.g. knowing how to solve the puzzle) of all events they are competing in.

It was recently brought to the WRC's attention that [Regulation A1c](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/#A1c)) arguably does not apply to Fewest Moves under the current structure of the WCA Regulations, because Article E does not refer to Article A.

However, one of the original motivations for Regulation A1c) was to allow Delegates to apply it to Fewest Moves, and the WRC has supported this intended use of A1c since its introduction.

The Regulations will be updated to reflect this, as well as clarifying that the allowed aids specified under [Regulation 2i1](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/#2i1)) are also allowed in Fewest Moves Solving.

translation.title: A1c 和 2i1 适用于最少步
translation.content:
说明：WRC 获悉此问题后，新增了规则 [2k6](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/full/#2k6)，要求选手满足所参加全部项目的要求，例如知道如何还原相应魔方。

近期有人向 WRC 指出，按当时 WCA 规则的结构，[A1c](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/#A1c) 或许不适用于最少步，因为第 E 章没有引用第 A 章。

然而，制定 A1c 的初衷之一，就是允许代表将其用于最少步。自其引入以来，WRC 一直支持这种预期用途。

规则将更新以体现这一点，并明确 [2i1](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/#2i1) 所列允许使用的辅助用品也可用于最少步。
